items.title: South Korean traders chase 40% coupons as risk appetite survives rout
items.description: Equity-linked securities dangling annualized coupons of 40% to 50% have attracted renewed interest from mom-and-pop traders

items.title: Juicy yields pull junk bond 'tourists' towards high-grade AI debt
items.description: The fact that investment-grade rated projects are tapping junk debt investors to get at least some bond deals done underscores the feverish competition for capital
